notes: Crystal rule. LUNGING. Gesture: wind-up and JAB (the saw-blade lead leaf cocks back and up, held, thrusts past its rest pose in 4 ticks and its hairs bristle on the strike, then it recoils). Only the lead leaf and the hairs move. Same two tones as the sprout. Sport: 'Beacon Silver'.
